name: Top-Brands
query:
SELECT 
    i.brand AS "Brand",  
    SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS "Total Stock"  
FROM 
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle  
JOIN 
    `tabItem` i ON sle.item_code = i.item_code  
WHERE 
    sle.docstatus = 1  -- Consider only submitted stock entries  
    AND i.brand IS NOT NULL  
    AND i.brand <> ''  
GROUP BY 
    i.brand  
ORDER BY 
    "Total Stock" DESC  
LIMIT 5;  -- Get the top 5 brands
